text:
Anna Chen: Quick sync — HW partner and marketplace teams want a joint announcement window. thinking about a staggered rollout: marketplace listing the week before HW press, then a joint demo day. thoughts? :speaker:
Max Patel: I like staggered. gives us time to bake the marketplace tile and analytics. can we confirm LangChain/LlamaIndex gateway demos will be ready?
Jaden Rivera: Gateways team: we have a beta adapter working but need one more e2e test with the SI flows (auth + large file indexing). ETA end of next week.
Li Wei: @Jaden can you paste the failing test logs? reproducing locally now.
Jaden Rivera: sure, here's the snippet i hit in CI:
```
ERROR: OrchestratorAdapterTimeout: KV cache warmup exceeded 30s
Trace: /runner/sync_adapter.py:213
```
Working on reducing warmup by adjusting prefetch batch size.
Sophie R.: From marketing: press embargo windows are tight. if marketplace goes live Mon, HW partner press is Thurs, we need final quote assets by Tue EOD. Can ops/eng commit to that?
Anna Chen: Action item list — short and sweet:
- Eng (gateways): stabilize e2e tests + reduce warmup (owner: Jaden) — due: next Fri
- Infra: enable sandbox clusters for SI demos (owner: Li) — due: Tue
- Marketing: draft joint announcement and partner quotes (owner: Sophie) — due: Tue EOD
- Partnerships: finalize co-marketing package and asset delivery (owner: Anna) — due: Tue EOD
Max Patel: For the marketplace tile, we need a small demo video (30s) showing Redwood + gateway + SI flow. Can product record a walkthrough? @Li can you spin a demo env?
Li Wei: I can stand up a short-lived demo VPC and share creds. will use the quantized model profile to match production latency.
Jaden Rivera: also toggling a fallback policy in orchestrator so if gateway latency spikes we route to a lighter model — reduces demo flakiness. will PR that today.
Sophie R.: Marketing checklist for announcement assets (short):
- 30s demo video (mp4)
- 3 screenshots (marketplace tile, gateway config, demo output)
- Partner quote (2 sentences)
- Launch blog draft (800–1000 words)
Please drop in the drive folder: https://drive.company/s/partners/launch-assets
Anna Chen: Risk callout — HW partner needs verification on hardware SKU compatibility with our Dedicated offering. @Max can you confirm procurement sign-off?
Max Patel: Talked to HW PM — they will confirm SKU matrix by Mon morning. their legal asked for a 48h embargo after press embargo — we should flag that to marketing.
Jaden Rivera: FYI we'll run the LangChain integration tests against the latest runner commit. If failures surface, we should push the marketplace tile to "preview" state rather than fully public.
Anna Chen: Good point. decision rule: if any critical e2e test fails within 48h of planned soft-launch, we flip to preview and delay press. everyone ok?
Sophie R.: ok — marketing will prepare two versions of the blog (full and preview) so we can toggle without rework.
Li Wei: I'll post the demo VPC details when it's up. expect IP allowlist + short-lived creds.
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: demo-sandbox -> teardown in 72h. Link: https://deploys.internal/runs/98432
Anna Chen: Great. I'll own the announcement timeline doc and send a final sync invite. Thanks all — will follow up with a concise checklist in this thread. :white_check_mark:
